author: KrakenDeploy
name: KrakenDeploy step package
description: A class library that produces a .kdeploy-step archive on `dotnet build`. Bundles a sample IStepHandler + a sample ui-schema.json so authors have a working starting point.

stepTypeId.description: The step type id this package handles (e.g. "MyCompany.DeployToS3"). Used in the manifest's stepTypes array.

packageId.description: The step-package id (lower-case, dotted; e.g. "mycompany.deploy-s3"). Goes into manifest.id and the produced .kdeploy-step filename.
